_comment: Hand-verified key-building loops in *Menu::createMenus (machine code of the pinned ELF). first/last are the GetValueAsString counter values; back_base/back_offset describe window+0x1d8 = &this->base[idx+offset], or null when the loop wires no back-pointer. Layout cross-checks in evidence notes.
